task: Two-stage trajectory combination-gap pilot authorized by the latest user request. Prior ten-hour search remains closed.
priority: Detection and extraction quality. No plugin-form requirement and no low-cost objective.

part1.cohort: All17 existing development trials;14 distinct tasks
part1.method: Deterministic source/AST/history analysis; no model calls. Rules may use historical gap feature families but may not use case identifiers, manually selected steps or evaluation labels.
part1.evaluation: Separate manual review of selected tests and trajectory evidence; permit irrelevant retrieved material; report target-test retrieval and evidence completeness separately.
part1.automatic_extraction_is_not: Proof that a gap or a defect exists.

part2.selection: Purposive manual pilot spanning observed validation-gap mechanisms; all development-seen.
arms: Manually selected source tests, public issue and original supporting source
Exactly same information plus manually selected original trajectory steps
part2.manual_annotation_boundary: Selection rationale and target gap labels remain evaluation-only. No later generated witness, hidden test, reference implementation or later research failure output enters generation. Original developer execution outputs are permitted trajectory information.
part2.generation: One request per case and arm, up to2 complete tests; same low-reasoning16384-output-token model settings; no outcome-guided retry.
part2.imports: Original bindings plus explicitly source-verified named imports; complete test-body transport and import identities checked.
part2.native: Execute all structurally accepted candidates with original source controls; repeat controlled failures once. No first-failure selection.
part2.evaluation: Independent full-test semantic audit and predeclared target-gap matching. Native failure alone does not count. Distinguish target-gap witness, other valid defect, invalid oracle/domain, passing test, extraction/transport failure and unknown.
part2.reason_for_no_model_semantic_prefilter: This pilot isolates generation capability. A second model false-negative gate would conflate generation with admission. All native execution still uses bounded original test harnesses and code-scope checks.

metrics: Part1 test-location retrieval and trajectory evidence coverage, including noise
Part2 predeclared target-gap detection per arm
Other valid defect detections reported separately
limitations: Manual context selection makes Part2 an upper-bound feasibility test, not end-to-end automatic performance.
One generation request per arm/case does not establish statistical significance.
No claim of universal zero false-positive rate.
Eight pilot trials are not a random sample; feature families were developed on these tasks.

part2_implementation_tests.independent_pair_check: All8 pairs differ only by original_trajectory_steps; all source-only contexts project away historical sources.

superseded_source_preparation.reason: Rebuilt with repository-only semantic context before any dispatch.
